description: This file defines the StatementPrefetchIterator class, which extends StatementBase and implements a prefetching iterator for database statements in Drupal. It manages data fetching, statement execution, and related database interactions, with deprecated properties and methods indicating evolution in the codebase.

classes.name: StatementPrefetchIterator
classes.description: An implementation of StatementInterface that prefetches all data, extending StatementBase to manage database statement execution and data retrieval with deprecated properties for backward compatibility.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the StatementPrefetchIterator with database connection, query, options, and enables row count if specified.

methods.name: getClientStatement
methods.description: Returns the PDOStatement object for the client database connection, throws exception if not initialized.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Prepares and executes the database statement, fetches all data, manages fetch modes, and dispatches relevant events.

methods.name: getStatement
methods.description: Prepares and returns a PDOStatement object for the given query and arguments.

methods.name: fetchColumn
methods.description: Deprecated method to fetch a single column value; recommends using fetchField() instead.
